entries.heading: CONFORMING AMENDMENT TO COUNCIL ON OVERSIGHT OF THE NATIONAL LEADERSHIP COMMAND, CONTROL, AND COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM
ancestors: TITLE XVI—STRATEGIC PROGRAMS, CYBER, AND INTELLIGENCE MATTERS
entries.text:
SEC. 1661. CONFORMING AMENDMENT TO COUNCIL ON OVERSIGHT OF THE 
                          NATIONAL LEADERSHIP COMMAND, CONTROL, 
                          AND COMMUNICATIONS SYSTEM.

    Section 171a of title 10, United States Code, is amended by striking 
``, Technology, and Logistics'' each place it appears and inserting 
``and Sustainment''.
